name: Microsoft Teams
description: Puts Teams requests meant for you in the Inbox (direct messages, @mentions, replies to your channel posts), and lets the agent search and read Teams while it works. Reads Teams through the Composio CLI signed in on this desktop.

settings.label: Days to look back the first time

tools.name: teams_search
tools.description: Search the owner's Microsoft Teams messages (chats and channels) by keywords, ticket ids, customer or product names, or people. Returns matching messages newest-relevant first, each with a snippet, author, time and ids to read more with teams_read_chat or teams_read_thread. Read-only.

query.description: Search words, e.g. a ticket id like PROJ-1482 or a customer name

tools.name: teams_recent_chats
tools.description: List the owner's most recent Teams chats (direct, group and meeting chats) with their ids, members or topic, and the latest message. Optionally filter by a person's name or a topic word. Read-only.

filter.description: Only chats whose topic or member names contain this

tools.name: teams_read_chat
tools.description: Read the latest messages of one Teams chat, oldest first. Give chat_id (from teams_search or teams_recent_chats) or person (a name, to open the direct chat with them). Read-only.

person.description: Name of the other person in a direct chat

tools.name: teams_read_thread
tools.description: Read a Teams channel post and its replies. Give link (a Teams message link) or team_id, channel_id and message_id from teams_search. Read-only.
